summary: Platform decoders were updated for compatibility and stability: support for a newer FFmpeg release was added, Vulkan-based video decoding (including VP9) has improved fallbacks and NVIDIA memory-layout handling was tuned, and access to DRM/CDM proxy state was synchronized to avoid race conditions. Together these fixes make hardware-accelerated video playback and protected (DRM) content decoding more reliable across GPUs and driver setups.
